g.text: Delivery speed: one work item's states (new states and transitions in bold)
rank 2; back to the column it left
CI on H (checks watcher, no park)
no slot held idle while CI runs
files overlap an item in Development..merged
the holding item merged, parked, closed or left;
pushed head H: Functional Testing starts at once
CI red on H, before or after the PASS
PASS on H and CI green on H
group green; master moves to the tested commit
master build reuses the group's build
when its commit is exactly master
one automatic retry when it cleared
